acceptance_criteria.description: ContextVM SBOM generate/import request types expose subjectLocator for package and repository immutable subject resolution.

Package subject resolution requires repository_id, package_name, version, filename, and sha256; it looks up the package artifact projection and rejects missing, deleted, invalid, or SHA-mismatched artifacts.

Repository subject resolution requires either a 40/64-hex git commit or a sha256:<64-hex> content_digest, rejects ambiguous commit+content_digest requests, and never infers digest from mutable repository names alone.
SBOM orchestration uses subjectLocator for both generate and import resolution paths while preserving explicit subject.digest behavior.
Design, user, and PSTF documentation define the canonical package and repository request field shapes and immutable-locator decision.
